name: Pane e Vino da Michele
kurzbeschreibung:
**

Pane e Vino da Michele in Tirol

** Discover the authentic Italian charm of **Pane e Vino da Michele** in the heart of **Tirol**. This cozy restaurant brings a taste of **Naples** to the alpine landscape, offering a warm and inviting atmosphere where every dish tells a story. Indulge in traditional **Neapolitan pizza**, baked in a wood-fired oven just like **Nonna** used to make. Savor the crispy yet soft crust, topped with fresh, high-quality ingredients like **San Marzano tomatoes**, creamy **mozzarella di bufala**, and aromatic **basil** from the garden. For those craving something heartier, their **pasta dishes** are a must—think **spaghetti alle vongole**, **lasagna alla bolognese**, or **gnocchi al ragù**, all prepared with love and a touch of **Italian nonchalance**. No Italian meal is complete without a glass of fine wine. Their **wine list** features carefully selected **Chianti**, **Barolo**, and **Prosecco**, paired perfectly with every bite. And how could we forget dessert? Treat yourself to a slice of **tiramisu** or a warm **cannoli**, or perhaps a classic **panna cotta** with fresh berries. **Pane e Vino da Michele** is more than just a restaurant—it’s an experience. Whether you're exploring **Innsbruck**, skiing in **St. Anton**, or simply enjoying the **Tiroler Alps**, this little gem will transport you straight to the sun-drenched streets of **Southern Italy**. **

Come for the food, stay for the atmosphere—Mangia, bevi, e goditi!

**
